Ramblings · September 5, 2026

Making room for unfinished thoughts

A home for ideas that need a little more space than a quick note.

Not every thought needs to arrive fully assembled. The Ramblings section is for the longer versions: observations, questions, and explorations that benefit from a few more paragraphs.

The only rule is to keep going long enough to find out what the thought is trying to say.

Made for notes, links, and whatever comes next.2026
